dialogue: "Evening. Name's [event_worker]. I've been working various jobs around town, but I'm looking for something more stable. I'm strong, reliable, and I don't cause trouble. What do you say?"

choices.option: Offer them a position immediately for [COST] per day.
choices.message: You extend a handshake and offer [COST] per day. [event_worker] accepts with a firm grip and steady smile. 'Fair deal. I'll start tomorrow morning.' They nod respectfully and leave, clearly a person of their word.

choices.option: Test their physical strength with a challenge. (70% chance of success)
choices.message_success: You propose a simple test of strength - moving some heavy crates. [event_worker] handles the task effortlessly, muscles working with practiced ease. 'I've done harder work,' they say with a slight grin. 'So, do I have the job?' They agree to work for [COST] daily.

choices.option: Negotiate for a trial period at reduced pay.

choices.option: Politely decline.
choices.message: You explain that you're not currently hiring. [event_worker] nods understandingly. 'No problem. If you change your mind, I'll be around.' They leave without any hard feelings.

description: A somewhat effeminate young man enters your establishment with a playful, knowing smile. He moves with a graceful, almost coquettish air, and his eyes sparkle with mischief and intelligence. There's something roguish about him - the way he carries himself suggests he's used to getting what he wants through charm and wit rather than brute force.
dialogue:
"Well, well, well... look what we have here."

[event_worker] leans against the doorway with a coy smile, his voice carrying a hint of playful seduction. "I'm [event_worker], and I've heard... interesting things about your establishment. I'm quite clever, you know. Good with people. And I have a certain... flexibility that might be valuable to you."

"I'm looking for work, but I'm not interested in just any job. I want something that appreciates my particular talents. What do you say?"

choices.option: Offer them [COST] per day immediately.
choices.message: You offer [COST] per day. [event_worker]'s smile widens, and he gives you an appraising look. 'Oh, I like someone who knows quality when they see it. Deal.' He extends a hand with a graceful, almost delicate gesture, but his grip is firm. 'I think we'll have fun working together.'

choices.option: Try to see through his charm and test his cleverness. (75% chance of success)

'Most people just fall for the act. You actually see me. I respect that.' He agrees to work for [COST] daily with increased relationship.
choices.message_failure: You try to test his cleverness, but [event_worker] is too quick for you. He sees through your attempt immediately and gives you a knowing, almost teasing look. 'Nice try, but I've been playing this game longer than you have.' He still accepts the position at [COST] per day, but there's a hint of amusement in his eyes - as if he's already won some unspoken game.

choices.option: Try to negotiate a lower wage using his own tactics.
choices.message: You attempt to match his roguish charm with some clever negotiation of your own. [event_worker] seems both surprised and impressed. 'Oh, you're trying to out-rogue the rogue? choices.option: Politely decline.
choices.message: You explain that you're not currently hiring. [event_worker]'s smile doesn't falter, but his eyes show a flicker of something - disappointment, perhaps, or maybe just calculation.
